item.title: Expert credits Trump tax certainty for economic confidence, Americans returning to workforce
item.description: The American workforce rebounds with unexpected job gains in January, signaling economic momentum as labor participation rises across demographics nationwide.

item.title: Ford CEO says 'customer has spoken’ after EV shift drives major quarterly loss
item.description: Ford reported a massive $11.1 billion quarterly loss driven by electric vehicle writedowns and tariff costs, marking the automaker's worst quarter since 2008.

item.title: Estée Lauder sues Walmart over alleged counterfeit beauty sales
item.description: The lawsuit filed by Estée Lauder claims Walmart’s marketplace model enabled sales of alleged knockoffs of products from Le Labo, La Mer and Tom Ford.

item.title: Barron Trump linked to beverage company based near Mar-a-Lago
item.description: Barron Trump is listed in public records as a partner in a new yerba mate beverage startup called SOLLOS, raising $1 million through private placement.

item.title: Activist sportswear brand XX-XY Athletics sees Super Bowl weekend marketing spike with year-old commercial
item.description: XX-XY Athletics sees sales triple after Super Bowl viral ad resurgence. The activist sportswear brand's commercial gained over 40 million views on X.

item.title: Heineken to cut up to 6,000 jobs globally, lowers profit growth forecast amid industry struggles
item.description: Heineken announces plans to cut up to 6,000 jobs globally as the beer giant faces weaker demand and expects slower profit growth through 2026.

item.title: NewsGuild battles New York Times over hybrid work, ‘wrongly excluding jobs’ from union and health fund
item.description: The NewsGuild of New York is irked at New York Times leadership over hybrid work, "wrongly excluding jobs" from union and its health fund.

item.title: Cake mixes now carry 'death' risk as FDA escalates recall to highest danger level over allergen
item.description: A nationwide recall affects hundreds of bags of cake and bread mixes containing undeclared milk that could trigger life-threatening reactions in allergic individuals.

item.title: Raising Cane’s begins 30-year anniversary with star-studded Super Bowl week celebration in San Francisco
item.description: To mark 30 years, Raising Cane’s hosted celebrities, athletes and influencers in San Francisco during Super Bowl week, blending football, pop culture and brand-building events.

item.title: Instagram chief compares 'addictive' platform to Netflix binge-watching during trial testimony: report
item.description: Instagram CEO Adam Mosseri reportedly compared using the platform to binge-watching Netflix while rejecting clinical addiction claims in Los Angeles trial.
